review.title: Nhận xét bài viết trên lớp
paragraphs: Some people argue that advertising can promote economic growth, while many others hold an adverse opinion, saying that this would cause negative social effects since it will make people dissatisfied with themselves and their money. In my opinion, there are strong cases to be made for both sides of the argument.

Firstly, advertising can bring undeniable economic benefits. People who agree with this opinion argue that creative content and appealing visual effects can stimulate consumer demand, meaning that spending power increases their life, the production are encouraged people to buy something. This means that employment opportunities and greater state revenues through taxation to have a strong economy. For instance, e-commerce platforms such as Lazada and Shopee in Vietnam rely heavily on advertising campaigns to attract customers, boosting not only their sales but also the entire digital retail sector. In this way, advertising creates jobs in marketing, media and design, making it an important driver of economic activity.

On other hand, advertising can have negative social consequences. People who agree with this opinion say that constantly show images of perfect lifestyles, beauty standards or luxury possessions can foster dissatisfaction among viewers. Continuously, young people in particular may feel pressured to buy trendy clothes or the latest smart gadgets advertised on TikTok, leading to frustration when they cannot afford them. Advertising can promote materialistic values and money-driven culture in the long run.
In conclusion, I think both opinions are right, when advertising will have true face of them.

paragraphs: Some people argue that news coverage has an excessive impact on their lives today and regard this trend as harmful. Personally, I acknowledge this considerable influence, although I do not regard it as entirely harmful.

It is undeniable that news has a strong impact on people's lives. This can be seen in how the widespread access to smartphones and the Internet allows people to use these technologies to follow news instantly, wherever and whenever they are. The news becomes a regular part of their routine. Moreover, the intense competition among news outlets also strengthens this influence. In order to gain attention, most media agencies focus on shocking and breaking content and present it in a highly sensationalized manner, with dramatic headlines and eye-catching visuals to reinforce the overall impact of news on public opinion.

Admittedly, news has negative effects, yet I believe that it also has good effects. Exposure to a constant stream of distressing and exaggerated news can overwhelm people, making them feel overly anxious and helpless, even in situations that do not directly affect them. However, news coverage warns the public to existing and looming problems in society, for instance, crime, natural disasters, or political corruption. Individuals are better informed and more prepared to respond to potential threats. In this way, individuals can handle risks in an increasingly complex society.
In conclusion, I am firmly convinced that news has a big influence on people's lives today and that it has both negative and positive effects.

review.title: Nhận xét bài viết trên lớp
paragraphs: Some people believe that students who study harder should have reward, while others argue that it is more crucial to reward students who excel in their study. I think that those who improve in study should be rewarded.

Admittedly, elite students can achieve to rewards. In this way, students who diligently applied themselves to their studies they deserve their praises and privileges. This may encourage these students and others to study harder to win the rewards and propel towards overall academic gains. For instance, this kind of competition can seen in almost every aspect of life where only the best individuals are rewarded. If students are used to this reality and thrive in the face of fierce competition, this can enable them to achieve success in later life.

However, students who are improve in studies should have rewards too. The fact that if only a few smart students can come first and receive the rewards. It can cause others to think that their effort is futile since they can't surpass those outstanding individuals and prone to feeling overwhelmed and disheartened to gradually lose the incentive to study. Furthermore, emphasizing improvements not only encourage all students to be diligent in their studies, but also can help students to understand that they need to constantly improve themselves and irrespective of how well they have been or performing. The constant desire to outdo themselves, lead them to even benefit themselves more than the competitive determination to win against all others.
In conclusion, I believe that elite students and student who more hard-working in their study should have reward.

paragraphs: Some people believe that students who make progress should receive rewards, while others argue that schools should reward those with the best academic results. I believe that both groups should be rewarded.

Admittedly, high-achieving students should be rewarded. This is because students who have diligently applied themselves to their studies deserve their praises and privileges. This may encourage these students and others to study harder to win the rewards and contribute to stronger results across the class. Furthermore, this kind of competition can be seen in almost every aspect of life where only the best individuals are rewarded. If students become used to this reality and thrive in the face of fierce competition, this may enable them to achieve success in later life.

However, students who make progress in their studies should also receive rewards. To begin with, if only a few high-achieving students receive rewards, this may cause others to think that their effort is futile since they cannot surpass those outstanding individuals and become prone to feeling overwhelmed and disheartened, gradually losing the incentive to study. Furthermore, emphasizing improvements not only encourages all students to be diligent in their studies, but also helps students to understand that they need to constantly improve themselves irrespective of how well they have been or are performing. The constant desire to outdo themselves may benefit them more than the competitive determination to win against all others.
In conclusion, I believe that both high-achieving students and those who have made progress in their studies should receive rewards.

paragraphs: Some parents choose to teach their children by themselves at home instead of sending them to school. I believe that it is disadvantages of home schooling outweigh the advantages.

Admittedly, home schooling allow parents to save money without school fees. Parents can educate their children at home less likely to experience bullying and peer pressure can cause both emotional and mental problems. Furthermore, parents teaching their children at home by themselves and tailor their young ones. It is often not the case in traditional schooling because of the large class size.

However, this educational approach isn't actually save money since parents need to pay a large amount of money for lab equipment and tutors by one parent having to be cut off can cater for their child's needs, be these academic or personal. In the fact that, home parents are not well to vers in all school subjects therefore difficulties in properly explaining concepts for children and ultimately academic problems. Even social problems that children are faced with at school considering bullying and having romantic feelings for other can make their children give up studying. Parents should prepare them for social and work place situation in the future.
In conclusion, I firmly convinced that home schooling is much more disadvantages than let their children to school.

paragraphs: Some parents choose to teach their children themselves at home instead of sending them to school. I believe that the disadvantages of homeschooling outweigh its advantages.

Admittedly, supporters of homeschooling argue that it brings several benefits. First, homeschooling may save parents money when they do not have to pay school fees. Second, children taught at home may be less likely to experience bullying and peer pressure, which can cause emotional and mental problems. Finally, parents who teach their children themselves may be able to tailor lessons to their needs. This can be harder in schools with large classes.

However, these apparent benefits may be outweighed by three major drawbacks. First, homeschooling may not actually save money as parents may have to pay for laboratory equipment and tutors. One parent may also reduce paid work to meet the child's academic and personal needs. Second, many parents are not well-versed in every school subject and may struggle to explain concepts to children, affecting their children's learning. Finally, children who study only at home may have fewer chances to handle social situations. At school, they may encounter bullying or develop romantic feelings for others. Serious bullying can disrupt study, while learning to handle such situations with help can prepare children for future social and workplace situations. Parents should prepare them for these experiences.
In conclusion, I am firmly convinced that the disadvantages of homeschooling outweigh its advantages.
